name: Stone sarcophagus
description: A heavy chest of worn grey stone, about 2.2 m long, 0.9 m wide and 1 m high, on a moulded plinth with a moulded rim and carved panels, its lid carved with the low relief of a lying knight with folded hands on his sword; cracked corners and a little moss in the joints.
